notice: Not every flagged item is a confirmed player-visible bug. Distinguish verified source/data defects, heuristic spatial flags, and unverified historical reports.

findings.topic: North Ring road centerline doubles back twice
findings.evidence: Two consecutive vertex turns 174.7 and 180.0 degrees at world positions (-523.05,-432), (-545.09,-432); a 22m backtrack between an inbound 75m and outbound 92m segment.
findings.action: Inspect route in chosen reference and actual car scene, then correct point ordering and regenerate route samples, pathfinding, pavement and collisions together.
findings.acceptance: Vehicles traverse northRing both ways without U-turn, clipping, unexplained braking or teleport; map layout remains unchanged.

findings.topic: Private Spine road has an extremely sharp turn
findings.evidence: privateSpine469 has a 135.9 degree centerline turn at (-887.61,-16.1), with adjoining segment lengths 42.8m/118.2m.
findings.action: Inspect camera/car route and if not intended, smooth transition without changing design reference.
findings.acceptance: AI and player maintain appropriate road-lane continuity through the bend.

findings.topic: Most door portals are not enterable
findings.evidence: 83 of 298 entrance portals have interiorReady=true; 215 are not available for entry.
findings.action: Open selected buildings first and create functional lobbies/floors with safe collision; avoid claiming all 298 are accessible.
findings.acceptance: Entry, floor changes, and return to street work in the selected target buildings, without fake decorative-only entries.

findings.topic: 130 new reference-mapped buildings were not supplied with new portals
findings.evidence: Stage02 explicitly adds decorative massing and collision solids but does not create new entrancePortals or interiorReady permissions.
findings.action: Plan interior access for important new district buildings; integrate with the existing entrance and structural plan pipeline.
findings.acceptance: Important mapped buildings have doors placed on usable street-facing sides and walkable interiors.

findings.topic: Every existing portal faces north
findings.evidence: All 298 entrancePortals have facing="north" in a real world build; no portals face south/east/west.
findings.action: Derive door orientation from the actual street-fronting facade and door/window geometry; preserve door IDs and working interior links.
findings.acceptance: Doors around test blocks align naturally with street faces without clipping into walls or traffic.

findings.topic: 130 mapped building footprints are all axis aligned
findings.evidence: Stage02 calls H.coastShape461 or H.box at yaw=0 for each generated mass; the stage02 district metadata does not include rotation.
findings.action: Rotate building orientations according to neighboring streets/blocks after geometry and collider audit.
findings.acceptance: Buildings relate to road directions instead of a globally uniform grid; parking and doors remain navigable.

findings.topic: New windows are concentrated on a single side
findings.evidence: Stage09 creates most window panes at facadeZ = building.z + building.depth/2 + 0.055; not a four-sided facade pass.
findings.action: Add window patterns on relevant visible sides while respecting room layout, draw budget and gameplay glass.
findings.acceptance: Building facade variety holds up from street corners and in overhead camera views.

findings.topic: 116 entrances classify as water; none are currently enterable
findings.evidence: The coast classifier marks 116/298 portal coordinates as water; the same probe finds zero interiorReady portals in that subset.
findings.action: Cross-check building foundations, actual water geometry and reference map before adjusting elevation/position.
findings.acceptance: No entrance or wall visually sits in incorrect water/terrain; no existing valid coastal portal is moved arbitrarily.

findings.topic: 181 outdoor planters remain in road/water-classified zones
findings.evidence: 181 of 596 Stage16 planter shrubs fail the coast/road safety heuristic after 55 planter sites were moved in earlier repair.
findings.action: Review scene-aligned coordinates and move only confirmed bad sites together with bases, canopies and bollards.
findings.acceptance: No props appear inside roads, canals or safe walking corridors; road and door map preserved.

findings.topic: 30 street lights could not be relocated safely
findings.evidence: Deep audit patch reports 30 unresolved decorative streetlamps, after 13 were relocated.
findings.action: Visually inspect unresolved lamp positions and place on valid sidewalks without blocking lanes or paths.
findings.acceptance: No streetlights float, overlap road lanes or clip building entrances.

findings.topic: Stage15 street props have no gameplay colliders
findings.evidence: Stage15 adds 2,284 visible street assets, including bollards, planters and lamps, with collisionsAdded=0 and unchanged world.solids.
findings.action: Add lightweight collision shapes selectively to truly solid props, keeping decorative leaves nonblocking and ensuring AI avoidance.
findings.acceptance: Player and vehicles cannot phase through bollards/planter bases in a controlled test.

findings.topic: Lobby furnishing coverage does not match number of ready entrances
findings.evidence: 83 portal entries are interiorReady; Stage11 decorates only 76 lobby plans and Stage13 processes only 71 for wayfinding/light fixtures.
findings.action: List exact 7/12 omitted portals by floor dimensions and supply compact layout variants where appropriate.
findings.acceptance: Every target ready lobby has working accessible fixtures and no fake inaccessible rooms.

findings.topic: Lobby lighting stage adds zero real dynamic lights
findings.evidence: Stage13 reports actualDynamicLightsAdded=0 and uses light_emissive visual meshes; Stage10 lamps are explicitly visual-only too.
findings.action: Use a limited, culled actual interior lighting strategy with baked/clustered fallbacks; confirm visual light impact.
findings.acceptance: Interior lamps visibly illuminate adjacent surfaces at night without breaking 50 FPS target.

findings.topic: CITY20 interior decorations are mostly visual-only overlays
findings.evidence: Stage11/12/13 explicitly add zero collisions and no newly navigable rooms or door permissions.
findings.action: Give chosen interior spaces usable collision, interactable elements and actual traversable floor layouts.
findings.acceptance: Furniture cannot be walked through where solid and working floors link to actual paths.

findings.topic: New facade glazing does not join the gameplay breakable-glass system
findings.evidence: Stage09 adds 864 visual glazing panels; the world.glassPanels collection contains 124 separately defined gameplay panels.
findings.action: Map selected facade and storefront glazing to glass interactions/damage via existing engine, using distance-based budget.
findings.acceptance: A controlled impact can affect intended windows without shattering unrelated decorative geometry.

findings.topic: Stage14 original storefront logic was inactive in full world
findings.evidence: Stage14 original portal descriptor filter matches zero live portals; a later deep-audit patch applies 342 corrective details to 60 venues.
findings.action: Consolidate real commercial metadata contracts and keep live-world regression tests; do not remove existing workaround before replacement.
findings.acceptance: All intended commercial venues have storefront metadata and stable visible entry/counter access.

findings.topic: Only 3 of 8 crocodiles can use high-detail model at once
findings.evidence: Wildlife model selector has crocodileBudget=3. There are eight crocodiles and no near/far crossfade.
findings.action: Implement continuous LOD with visually matching low/mid models and a model budget tuned on real hardware.
findings.acceptance: No abrupt model silhouette changes in a fixed-distance fly-in/walk-in test; GPU budget monitored.

findings.topic: Save/load does not restore the full physical game state
findings.evidence: LocalStorage persists profile/missions/crime/rewards/story/weather/volume, but no complete avatar position, live vehicle condition or time-of-day snapshot path is present.
findings.action: Design versioned save-state with a migration path and recovery tests, retaining the current localStorage data keys.
findings.acceptance: Reload returns to a user-saved position and important gameplay/vehicle state without corrupting old progress.

findings.topic: Pedestrian navigation uses simple local street routing
findings.evidence: Recovery5 fixed a time-key navigation bug; report says network is still a simple sidewalk graph without global robust planning for every complex intersection.
findings.action: Stress navigation around bridges/interiors/large crowds and improve route planning for actual observed stalls.
findings.acceptance: Pedestrians navigate crossings and varied streets in 10+ minute real play without repeated deadlocks or teleportation.

findings.topic: Physics substeps are not continuous collision detection
findings.evidence: Movement recovery limits walking to 5 and driving to 6 substeps, explicitly not a mathematically complete CCD solution.
findings.action: Test high-speed and narrow collision scenarios across level changes; patch any reproducible tunneling or launch.
findings.acceptance: No collision tunneling or arbitrary vehicle hanging at critical bridges and roadside solids.

findings.topic: 1080p/50FPS goal has no real hardware certification
findings.evidence: Current live browser cannot navigate local game (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR), and fake renderer CPU tests cannot validate visual/GPU FPS.
findings.action: Run at least three 20-second native 1920x1080 sessions per required scene on target PC and document p95/p99 frames; optimize based on actual bottleneck.
findings.acceptance: At least 50 sustainable display FPS plus p95<=20ms in target scenes, with internal render buffer actually 1920x1080.

findings.topic: Large JS/game world increases performance and memory risk
findings.evidence: 191,357 world display boxes, 59 script references, 21.4MB engine44.js, and 156.7MB of asset directory data (many high-detail assets load on demand).
findings.action: Profile startup, draw calls, garbage collection and LOD budget; do not assume total asset bytes are all loaded at page startup.
findings.acceptance: No unacceptable startup delay, frame spikes or memory growth in real 10+ minute sessions.

findings.topic: Recovery7 completion is contradicted by older progress metadata
findings.evidence: PROJECT/CITY20_PROGRESS.json still indicates phases 1..6 completed and nextPhase=7 although PROJECT/RECOVERY_STATUS.json clearly confirms 7/7.
findings.action: Update only the progress metadata and explain Stage1 is a NEW 15-stage QA plan, not redoing Recovery7.
findings.acceptance: All progress files agree about Recovery 7/7 and Stage 1 status.

findings.topic: Current full game is not standalone one-file HTML
findings.evidence: START_GAME.html references 59 local JavaScript modules; the 288-file ZIP must be extracted and served or opened with compatible local file permissions.
findings.action: At final stage package for GitHub Pages and optionally an optimized self-contained delivery if feasible without losing models.
findings.acceptance: Player can open the published game without manually installing dependencies.

findings.topic: Past 4.7.6 bug protocol must be re-verified in current build
findings.evidence: Historical reports include floating car parts, broken curved bridge railings, repeated AI crashes, unnatural slopes, camera clipping and confusing vehicle/foot interactions. Several related code fixes exist after 4.7.6, so not confirmed current bugs.
findings.action: Reproduce each old screenshot route in live current game and close only with before/after evidence; prioritize critical bridge/car issues.
findings.acceptance: Bug ledger records PASS/FAIL/NOT TESTED with exact scene screenshots and coordinates.

trafficCPU.disclaimer: Short isolated traffic-only CPU run is not enough to certify traffic accident rate or lack of bugs.
